restrictions: Two-block ordinary collisions M0||M1, M0||M1' of 128 bytes on the complete padded sha256-r31 target from the standard IV; the difference is confined to W5..W9 of the second block (Li-Liu-Wang 2024 Table 6, restated in proof.md section 3).

One fixed public starting point (proof.md section 4); a 2560-entry pair table keyed by A(-1); four W5 difference classes; B = 2^48 first blocks M0(i) = BE_32(i)||BE_32(r) with one fresh uniform word r.
Every returned pair is verified by recomputing both complete hashes; heuristics affect only success probability and cost.
Pricing: collision-frontier-v5, one selected compression = 1, other word operations 1/2140, with two operations charged per executed instruction (primitive plus fetch).
The time bound includes a declared 2^46-unit charge for the historical computation that produced the public characteristic and starting point (H-HISTORICAL-COST).
Exploratory heuristic estimate; not a full-scale execution and not a rigorous proof of the success probability.

heuristics.statement: For distinct first blocks M0(i), the chaining words (A-1, A-2, A-3) = (h0, h1, h2) and the remaining words h3..h7 of f(IV, M0(i)) behave, for the bitmap, V6, V5 membership events and the Step 3 success event, as independent uniform draws across i, giving a per-block full-match probability 2^-45.678 and success probability at least 2^-48.860.
heuristics.scope: The 31-round compression from the standard IV on 2^48 counter-indexed first blocks; events defined by 32-bit equalities and set memberships on the output words.
heuristics.extrapolation: Standard modelling assumption of two-block collision attacks (Mendel-Nad-Schlaeffer 2013; Li-Liu-Wang 2024); events of probability about 2^-46 are not observed directly.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved and not tested at full scale; a structural bias of the reduced compression on these words would change the match rate. The rate enters the score logarithmically.

heuristics.statement: Given a full match in class t, the completion of proof.md section 5.4 succeeds with probability at least the 99% Hoeffding lower bounds 0.1053, 0.1148, 0.1148, 0.1059 for the four classes, and succeeds whenever an admissible W18 exists.
heuristics.scope: Step 3 on matched states from the fixed starting point, with uniformly distributed free chaining words A-4, E-4..E-1.
heuristics.extrapolation: Author Monte Carlo over uniform C = W11 + s0(W3) + W2 (10^6 samples per class) and 12,000 simulated full matches with zero post-W18 failures; one real matched state (the published M0) completes on every organizer seed in the experiment.
heuristics.limitations: The simulation assumes the free chaining words of real matches are uniform (H-UNIFORM); author computations are not organizer-executed. The experiment covers one real match only.

heuristics.statement: The total historical computation that produced the public 31-step characteristic (Table 6) and the starting point is at most 2^46 target-compression units under collision-frontier-v5 pricing.
heuristics.scope: SAT/SMT characteristic search, starting-point solving, and the practical search that produced the published pair from which the starting point is read.
heuristics.extrapolation: The published practical search took 1.2 hours on 64 threads; 2^46 units correspond to about 1,700 core-hours at 3 GHz at 8 word operations per cycle; the characteristic-search time is not reported.
heuristics.limitations: The characteristic-search computation is not publicly reported and cannot be verified here. Sensitivity: 2^48 historical units would give time_log2 about 49.05.
